title: Inter without Çalhanoğlu vs Stuttgart, per Sportmediaset
caption:
Inter without Çalhanoğlu against Stuttgart? He will miss Wednesday’s Champions League game and both Genoa games, and could be out at least three weeks, per Sportmediaset — which names Stanković as the natural replacement. Inter are 15th in the Champions League table, one point behind Stuttgart, per Inter.it. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
